clusters.name: After the birth of a third child, 1995-1996
clusters.reason: Around the birth of a third child in 1995, you saw the mother worn out and on edge within months, then the father working late and distant from her by that fall, your own stomach aches and missed school the following winter, shouting matches between father and brother in the spring, and the mother not returning to her job by the next fall, all piling up within about a year and a half of the birth.
